_about: A330-300, from Airbus AC A330 (Dec 01/25) 2-2-0 General Aircraft Dimensions, A330-300 sheets 1 (side, front: page index 59) and 2 (plan: page index 60). Pixels of layers.py --mode strokes-in-fill rasters, line centres: the side at scale 16 turned level (--rotate -0.46), the plan at scale 15.147 (the side sheet's 81.56 px a meter; that sheet is drawn larger). Scaled by the printed 63.67 m overall length from the nose to the tail cone, which also gives the printed 5.64 m fuselage height. The windows behind the wing's lines and one behind a dimension line are placed at the drawing's pitch (windowsAlso); door 3 (the overwing Type I door) is drawn only above the wing: its height is a door 3's.

sources.title: Airbus, A330 Aircraft Characteristics: Airport and Maintenance Planning (Dec 01/25), 2-2-0 General Aircraft Dimensions, A330-300 sheets 1 and 2
sources.note: Dimensions and outlines read off the side, plan and front views (tools/trace/a333/); the figures are the aircraft's measurements, not a copy of the drawing. The side view is turned level from the sheet's ground attitude (0.46°). Engine out from the centerline: half the printed 18.74 m between the engines. The cabin windows are the drawing's; those behind the wing's lines are placed at its pitch.
